thread:
Priya S: quick question — using the embeddings batch/pagination helper and seeing a dims mismatch error. stack below. Anyone ran into this? :eyes:

Priya S: error: "EmbeddingDimMismatch: expected dim=1536 but got dim=1024" when calling embed_batch(paginate=True). I'm passing model='text-embed-redwood-large' and some items come back smaller.

Marco L: are these items mixed sources? i.e., some pre-computed vectors from older model in the same batch/store?

Priya S: nope, fresh texts only. small test: 3 docs, same pipeline, call returns two 1536 and one 1024. weird.

Alex K: can you paste the request payload (redact text) and the raw embedding shapes? also which SDK version?

Priya S: SDK v0.9.2. payload like: {"texts": ["...","...","..."], "model": "text-embed-redwood-large", "batch_size": 64, "paginate": true} — response snippet: 

```
[1536, 1536, 1024]
Error: EmbeddingDimMismatch(expected=1536, got=1024)
```

Sam T: hmmm — two quick possibilities: 1) model routing fallback to a smaller model on one shard, 2) client helper is accidentally re-using an emb result from previous call (cache).

Jin M: do we have any per-request routing that can swap models? the helper should pin model param on each sub-request but I can imagine a bug where paginate uses default model for later pages.

Priya S: good point. I traced network calls — page 1 POST uses model=text-embed-redwood-large, page 2 POST shows no model key in JSON (SDK bug?) and server used default smaller embed model.

Alex K: that explains mismatch — server generated 1024 on second page. quick workaround: specify model in the client options explicitly for paginate (or don't rely on default). we should also fail-fast in helper if dims differ across pages.

Priya S: workaround worked, thx. FYI adding explicit model param fixed it. but can we add validation in helper to detect inconsistent dims across paged responses and raise clearer error?

Sam T: yes please — we should add a validation step: after first page, record dim = len(emb[0]) and for subsequent pages assert equality. If mismatch, raise EmbeddingDimMismatch with hint: "possible model routing fallback or mixed stored vectors; include request ids".

Jin M: I'll draft a tiny patch. idea: on paginate loop do: 

```py
# pseudo
first_dim = None
for page in paginator:
    resp = api.embed(page.texts, model=params.model, ...)
    d = len(resp.embeddings[0])
    if first_dim is None:
        first_dim = d
    elif d != first_dim:
        raise EmbeddingDimMismatch(f"expected {first_dim}, got {d}; check model param on all pages")
    accumulate(resp)
```

I'll also add a test that simulates server fallback by returning different dims for page 2.

Priya S: that would be super helpful. can we also surface which page/request id caused mismatch in error message? it would speed debugging.

Alex K: include server request-id header if available. prefer error message like: "EmbeddingDimMismatch(expected=1536, got=1024) on page=2 request-id=xyz-123. Likely model param missing on paged request."

Priya S: another edge: if user is merging precomputed vectors with new ones (same batch helper used to post a mix), we should detect dims when writing to vector store too. but that's separate. posting here in case it's related.

Marco L: confirm — this crop of bugs mostly from paginate not propagating model param when paginate=true and from client-level caching that may reuse older emb blobs. good to add both assertions and disable caching across different model params.

Sam T: I'll file a small SDK issue and label it P1 for next patch. @Jin M can you link the PR when ready? :thumbsup:

Jin M: yep — creating PR now. will include unit test and an integration test that uses a fake server returning 2 dims. also a small doc note about always passing explicit model to paginate.

ci-bot: build queued for branch/emb-dim-validate — job 4821

Priya S: thanks all. follow-up: any recommendations for user-facing retry/backoff when embedding large batches with pagination? I'm seeing occasional 500 on page 3 and helper retries whole page which is fine but sometimes duplicates if page commits partially downstream.

Alex K: retries should be idempotent for embed calls, but if you commit embeddings to DB mid-loop you should either: 1) write on successful page and track offsets, 2) use transactional upsert to dedupe duplicates, or 3) stream embeddings to a queue and ack after DB commit. For SDK helper, we keep retry limited to per-page and expose hooks: on_page_success(page_idx, embeddings) so the caller can decide commit semantics.

Priya S: great — I'll use on_page_success and a simple offset checkpoint file. thanks everyone :heart:

Marco L: noted for release notes — add a short blurb: "embed_batch(paginate=True) now validates embedding dim across pages; please pass explicit model param to avoid routing fallbacks."

Sam T: tagging infra to check why server defaults are smaller model for missing model key — that routing should not happen for customer-visible endpoints.

Priya S: closing the loop here — patch merged, QAed on staging, will roll to prod tomorrow. :tada:
